title: CODE I/O: Condensing Reasoning Patterns via Code Input-Output Prediction
authors_zh: Junlong Li、Daya Guo、Dejian Yang、Runxin Xu、Yu Wu、Junxian He
paper_type_zh: 执行校验推理示范数据集与两阶段 SFT 配方
best_for_zh: 适合从可执行代码构造广域推理监督，或审计带反馈纠错轨迹的研究者。
one_line: CODE I/O transforms 454.9K executable functions into 3.52M CoT prediction records, while publicly releasing the ODC-BY PythonEdu-Reasoning subset.
CODE I/O 把 454.9K 个可执行函数转化为 3.52M 条带程序校验与修订反馈的自然语言推理示范，并公开其中的 PythonEdu-Reasoning 子集。
why: It exposes diverse program logic as natural-language reasoning supervision and makes prediction correctness, feedback, and revision visible in the serialized record.
inclusion_reason: CODE I/O releases teacher-written CoT, execution feedback, and revision records that are explicitly consumed as SFT targets; the central reusable object is demonstration data rather than raw code pretraining.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Reasoning supervision is abundant for mathematics and code generation but sparse and fragmented for logic, science, symbolic, and commonsense tasks. Raw-code pretraining hides useful procedures behind syntax and unrelated implementation details, while text-to-code supervision still rewards code production rather than transferable natural-language reasoning.

CODE I/O converts raw programs into executable functions and asks a teacher to explain either the output for a given input or a feasible input for a given output. Execution checks the prediction, and CODE I/O++ preserves the feedback plus one revision turn, producing about 3.52M CoT training records from 454.9K functions.

L4 facts: primary source ICML 2025, PMLR 267:34471-34489, https://proceedings.mlr.press/v267/li25t.html; data object and decision boundary are the prompt, first CoT prediction, execution feedback, optional revision, and re-check; the full construction and evaluation evidence are verified, but the release covers only PythonEdu-Reasoning and does not disclose its exact row count.

数学与代码生成已经拥有大量结构化推理监督，但逻辑、科学、符号和常识任务的数据仍然稀疏且碎片化。直接用原始代码继续预训练会让有用过程被语法与无关实现细节遮蔽，文本到代码监督则仍以生成代码为目标，难以直接迁移成自然语言推理能力。

CODE I/O 把原始程序改造成可执行函数，再让 teacher 解释给定输入的输出，或给定输出的一组可行输入。程序执行负责检查预测；CODE I/O++ 还保留反馈与一次修订，最终从 454.9K 个函数构造约 3.52M 条 CoT 训练记录。

L4 事实：主要来源为 ICML 2025，PMLR 267:34471-34489，https://proceedings.mlr.press/v267/li25t.html；数据对象与判定边界是 prompt、首轮 CoT 预测、执行反馈、可选修订与复查；完整构造与评测证据已核对，但公开发布只覆盖 PythonEdu-Reasoning 子集，且未披露其准确行数。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
CODE I/O exposes program logic as natural-language CoT by pairing an executable function with a known input or output and asking DeepSeek-V2.5 to predict the missing side; cached-answer matching or re-execution supplies correctness feedback, and CODE I/O++ appends one revision instead of discarding wrong first attempts. These serialized explanations and correction turns are two-stage SFT targets, so the work belongs to instruction/demonstration/rationale data rather than raw-code pretraining or a code benchmark.

Google Scholar citations: 55（checked 2026-07-27；https://scholar.google.com/scholar_lookup?title=CODE+I%2FO%3A+Condensing+Reasoning+Patterns+via+Code+Input-Output+Prediction&author=Junlong+Li&hl=en）

Open dataset: yes, with a documented release limitation. Dataset name: CodeIO-PyEdu-Reasoning. Official URL: https://huggingface.co/datasets/hkust-nlp/CodeIO-PyEdu-Reasoning. Scale: the full paper pipeline creates about 3.52M samples, while the public subset is one 11,225,166,333-byte JSONL file and its exact row count is not disclosed. Record form: prompt, turn_1, feedback_1, optional turn_2, and feedback_2. File/storage format: pyedur_full.jsonl. Domains/languages: English natural-language traces over educational Python functions spanning STEM, systems, logic puzzles, and other reasoning code. Construction and filtering: DeepSeek-V2.5 normalizes code and writes predictions; Python execution filters unusable functions and checks predictions, while wrong responses remain with feedback and optional revision. License/access constraints: public, ungated ODC-BY; only the PythonEdu-Reasoning subset is released because of collaborator compliance requirements. Intended use: reasoning SFT and distillation before general instruction tuning.

CODE I/O 把可执行函数与一个已知输入或输出配对，让 DeepSeek-V2.5 预测缺失的一侧，从而把程序逻辑展开成自然语言 CoT；缓存答案匹配或重新执行程序会给出正确性反馈，CODE I/O++ 再附加一次修订，而不是直接丢弃错误首答。这些解释与纠错轮次直接作为两阶段 SFT target，因此本工作属于指令、示范与理由数据，而不是原始代码预训练或代码 benchmark。

Google Scholar 引用数：55（查询于 2026-07-27；https://scholar.google.com/scholar_lookup?title=CODE+I%2FO%3A+Condensing+Reasoning+Patterns+via+Code+Input-Output+Prediction&author=Junlong+Li&hl=en）

开源数据：有，但存在明确的发布范围限制。数据集名称：CodeIO-PyEdu-Reasoning。官方地址：https://huggingface.co/datasets/hkust-nlp/CodeIO-PyEdu-Reasoning。规模：论文完整流程构造约 3.52M 条样本；公开子集是一个 11,225,166,333 字节的 JSONL 文件，发布页未披露准确行数。记录形式：prompt、turn_1、feedback_1、可选 turn_2 与 feedback_2。文件/存储格式：pyedur_full.jsonl。领域/语言：英文自然语言轨迹，底层是覆盖 STEM、系统、逻辑谜题及其他推理任务的教育类 Python 函数。构造与筛选：DeepSeek-V2.5 规范化代码并写预测，Python 执行删除不可用函数并检查答案；错误回答仍随反馈和可选修订保留。许可/访问限制：公开、无需审批、采用 ODC-BY；因合作方合规要求，只发布 PythonEdu-Reasoning 子集。预期用途：通用 instruction tuning 之前的推理 SFT 与蒸馏。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Collect and filter code. Merge about 810.5K raw files from CodeMix, PythonEdu-R, and smaller algorithm, mathematics, and coding sources. CodeMix keeps medium-difficulty files; PythonEdu-R removes pure algorithms and non-reasoning code.
  2. Normalize functions. DeepSeek-V2.5 extracts the main logic into an executable entry function, removes file/visualization side effects, specifies JSON-serializable inputs and outputs, writes a query, and creates a constrained input generator.
  3. Create I/O tasks. Run each input generator, execute the function, and reject randomness, failures, timeouts, and overly complex objects. This leaves 454.9K functions and about 3.52M nearly balanced input-prediction and output-prediction instances.
  4. Write and check traces. Prompt DeepSeek-V2.5 with the query, function, I/O specification, and one known side of the pair. Check output predictions against cached ground truth and input predictions by re-execution; the result can be success, mismatch, exception, no answer, or timeout.
  5. Build CODE I/O++. If the first prediction is wrong, append the execution feedback and request one revision, then re-check it. Roughly 50% are initially correct and about 10% of the incorrect responses recover; both correct and incorrect final records are retained.
  6. Train in two stages. Run one epoch of CODE I/O or CODE I/O++ SFT, then 700 steps on 1.18M general instruction samples. Evaluate the resulting Qwen, Llama, DeepSeek, and Gemma models across 14 reasoning measurements.

Reproduction must pin raw-source revisions, teacher version, transform prompts, Python environment, timeout/object limits, input-generator seeds, execution result, and public-subset revision. The paper does not disclose one complete generation-cost budget.

1. 收集并筛选代码。 从 CodeMix、PythonEdu-R 以及较小的算法、数学与在线编程来源合并约 810.5K 个原始文件。CodeMix 只保留中等难度文件，PythonEdu-R 删除纯算法和非推理代码。
  2. 规范化函数。 DeepSeek-V2.5 把主要逻辑抽成可执行入口函数，删除文件读写与可视化副作用，声明可 JSON 序列化的输入输出，再编写自然语言问题和满足约束的输入生成器。
  3. 构造 I/O 任务。 运行输入生成器和目标函数，删除带随机性、无法执行、超时或对象过于复杂的样本，最终得到 454.9K 个函数与约 3.52M 条大致各占一半的输入预测和输出预测实例。
  4. 生成并检查轨迹。 把问题、函数、I/O 说明和已知一侧交给 DeepSeek-V2.5。输出预测与缓存真值匹配，输入预测则通过重新执行检查；结果可能是成功、不匹配、异常、无答案或超时。
  5. 构造 CODE I/O++。 首答错误时附加执行反馈并要求修订一次，再次执行检查。约 50% 样本首轮正确，错误首答中约 10% 能修正；最终无论正确与否都保留。
  6. 两阶段训练。 先对 CODE I/O 或 CODE I/O++ 训练一轮，再用 1.18M 条通用 instruction 样本训练 700 步，最后在 14 组推理测量上评估 Qwen、Llama、DeepSeek 与 Gemma backbone。

复现必须固定原始来源 revision、teacher 版本、转换 prompt、Python 环境、超时与对象复杂度限制、输入生成器随机种子、每次执行结果和公开子集 revision。论文没有披露完整的生成成本预算。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
1. On Qwen2.5-Coder-7B, the general-instruction-only baseline averages 54.8 across the reported measurements; CODE I/O reaches 57.2 and CODE I/O++ 57.7. The corresponding Llama-3.1-8B averages are 49.3, 51.2, and 52.1. Because stage two and evaluation stay fixed, these comparisons support the value of the executable I/O traces and feedback-bearing revisions.
  1. The source and objective ablations bound that claim. A roughly 50% CODE I/O subset averages 56.7 on Qwen2.5-Coder-7B versus 57.2 for the full set, while removing CodeMix falls to 56.3 and removing PyEdu-R reaches 57.0. Rejecting wrong responses is also weaker than keeping feedback-bearing records, so scale, source diversity, and explicit correction context all contribute; no single component explains every gain.

1. 在 Qwen2.5-Coder-7B 上，只做通用 instruction tuning 的 baseline 平均分为 54.8，加入 CODE I/O 后为 57.2，使用 CODE I/O++ 后为 57.7；Llama-3.1-8B 的对应结果是 49.3、51.2 与 52.1。第二阶段训练和评测不变，因此这组比较支持可执行 I/O 轨迹及带反馈修订的训练价值。
  1. 数据来源与目标消融限定了结论边界。Qwen2.5-Coder-7B 使用约 50% CODE I/O 时平均 56.7，完整数据为 57.2；删除 CodeMix 降到 56.3，删除 PyEdu-R 为 57.0。仅拒绝错误回答也弱于保留反馈的记录，说明规模、来源多样性与显式纠错上下文都会贡献收益，但没有单一成分能解释全部提升。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Raw-code continual pretraining and text-to-code SFT preserve code syntax as the learning target, while ordinary rejection sampling removes failed generations. CODE I/O changes the auditable object to a natural-language I/O prediction trace tied to an executable function; CODE I/O++ additionally keeps the wrong attempt, concrete execution feedback, and one revised attempt in the same record. ICML acceptance, consistent two-backbone gains, and an executable public construction pipeline are quality signals. Code execution, teacher distillation, and self-correction are not individually new; the direction signal is their use to expose broad program reasoning as feedback-bearing SFT data. Reuse checks must separate the public PythonEdu subset from the unreleased CodeMix mixture and test whether incorrect CoTs teach useful correction or persistent error patterns.

原始代码继续预训练和文本到代码 SFT 都把代码语法保留为学习目标，普通 rejection sampling 则直接删除失败生成。CODE I/O 把可审计对象改成与可执行函数绑定的自然语言 I/O 预测轨迹；CODE I/O++ 还把错误尝试、具体执行反馈和一次修订保存在同一条记录中。ICML 接收、两个 backbone 上的一致提升与可执行的公开构造流程构成质量信号。代码执行、teacher 蒸馏与自我纠错各自都不是新概念；真正的方向信号是用它们把广泛程序逻辑展开成带反馈的 SFT 数据。复用时必须区分公开 PythonEdu 子集与未公开 CodeMix 混合，并检验错误 CoT 究竟训练了有效修订还是固化了错误模式。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
• Release mismatch. The main results use a 3.52M mixture including in-house CodeMix, but only PythonEdu-Reasoning is public. Reproduce both the public subset and a documented replacement mixture before attributing the paper's full average gains to downloadable data.
  • Verification is outcome-level. Execution can confirm the predicted I/O while leaving an unfaithful or inefficient rationale untouched, and wrong final traces are deliberately retained. Sample traces for step-level consistency and compare training with correct-only, feedback-only, and full-revision variants.
  • Code and evaluation lineage can overlap. Only LeetCode-O has an explicit training-overlap exclusion, while upstream repositories have heterogeneous licenses and provenance. Hash source files, scan all downstream benchmarks for semantic overlap, and retain source-level license records.

• 发布范围与主实验不一致。 主结果使用包含内部 CodeMix 的 3.52M 条混合数据，公开部分只有 PythonEdu-Reasoning。归因完整论文收益前，应分别复现公开子集和一个文档齐全的替代混合。
  • 校验只覆盖结果。 程序执行可以确认预测 I/O，却不能证明自然语言理由忠实或高效，而且设计还主动保留错误轨迹。应逐步抽查一致性，并比较只保留正确样本、只保留反馈和完整修订三种训练变体。
  • 代码来源与评测可能重叠。 只有 LeetCode-O 明确排除了训练中出现的问题，上游仓库的许可和 provenance 也不统一。应保存源文件哈希，对所有下游 benchmark 做语义重叠扫描，并保留逐来源许可记录。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
• Use the released JSONL when the goal is to teach a base model to express executable procedures as natural-language reasoning and to respond to concrete correction feedback before general instruction tuning.
  • A training input is the prompt; the target is the first trace plus feedback and, when present, the revised trace plus final check. Success should be measured against a stage-two-only baseline across non-code as well as code benchmarks.
  • Reuse the pipeline for new deterministic functions by preserving source ID, cleaned code, generator seed, I/O pair, teacher version, all execution outcomes, and sandbox digest. Do not use it when only faithful process supervision or a fully redistributable copy of the paper's complete mixture is acceptable.

• 当目标是在通用 instruction tuning 之前，让 base model 学会用自然语言表达可执行过程并响应具体纠错反馈时，可以使用公开 JSONL。
  • 训练输入是 prompt，target 是首轮轨迹与反馈，以及存在时的修订轨迹和最终检查；成功标准应是在代码与非代码 benchmark 上都优于只做第二阶段训练的 baseline。
  • 在新确定性函数上复用流程时，应保存来源 ID、清洗代码、生成器种子、I/O pair、teacher 版本、全部执行结果与 sandbox 摘要。不适合要求忠实过程监督，或必须完整再分发论文全部训练混合的场景。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. The full construction starts with 810.5K files and yields 454.9K executable functions and about 3.52M I/O-prediction traces.
  2. DeepSeek-V2.5 writes every CoT; program execution checks the JSON prediction, not each prose reasoning step.
  3. CODE I/O++ keeps wrong first attempts, execution feedback, and one revision instead of using rejection sampling.
  4. The clean headline comparison is Qwen2.5-Coder-7B average 54.8 to 57.2 to 57.7 for baseline, CODE I/O, and CODE I/O++.
  5. The ODC-BY public artifact is only a PythonEdu-Reasoning JSONL subset; the complete CodeMix-heavy training mixture is not released.

1. 完整构造从 810.5K 个文件开始，得到 454.9K 个可执行函数与约 3.52M 条 I/O 预测轨迹。
  2. 所有 CoT 都由 DeepSeek-V2.5 编写；程序执行只检查 JSON 预测，不逐步验证文字理由。
  3. CODE I/O++ 不做简单拒绝采样，而是保存错误首答、执行反馈与一次修订。
  4. 最清晰的结果是 Qwen2.5-Coder-7B 平均分从 baseline 54.8 提升到 CODE I/O 的 57.2 和 CODE I/O++ 的 57.7。
  5. 采用 ODC-BY 的公开 artifact 只是 PythonEdu-Reasoning JSONL 子集，完整的 CodeMix 主导训练混合并未发布。
